page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 36 Gbps. The lack of integrated local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU execution capacity and high-throughput networking over localized data caching or parallelized graphics acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c9i.32xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory allocations. Recommended workloads include high-performance computing, intensive web serving, batch processing, and large-scale compilation tasks.
